# Physical and Biological Features of Critical Habitat in the Action Area

```{r species_table, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(flextable)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(officer)

# --- 1. SPECIES SUMMARY TABLE ---
df_spp <- params$data_list[[1]]

if (!is.null(df_spp)) {
  ft_spp <- df_spp %>%
    mutate(PBF_category = ifelse(is.na(PBF_category) | PBF_category == "", "", PBF_category)) %>%
    group_by(Species_full, PBF_category) %>%
    summarise(
      pbf_list = paste0("  • ", unique(PBF), collapse = "\n"),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(category_block = if_else(PBF_category == "", 
                                    pbf_list, 
                                    paste0(PBF_category, ":\n", pbf_list))) %>%
    group_by(Species_full) %>%
    summarise(
      `Species (ESU/DPS)` = first(Species_full),
      `Physical and Biological Features` = paste(category_block, collapse = "\n\n"),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    select(-Species_full) %>%
    flextable() %>%
    theme_vanilla() %>%
    width(j = 1, width = 1.5) %>% 
    width(j = 2, width = 5.0) %>%
    valign(valign = "top", part = "all") %>%
    border_inner_h(border = fp_border(color="gray80", width = 1))

  ft_spp
}

# --- 2. DEFINE STRESSOR FORMATTING FUNCTION ---
format_st_table <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(PBF_category = ifelse(is.na(PBF_category) | PBF_category == "", "", PBF_category)) %>%
    group_by(PBF_category, PBF) %>%
    summarise(
      Species_List = paste0(unique(Species_full), collapse = "\n"),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(PBF_Display = if_else(PBF_category == "", 
                                 PBF, 
                                 paste0(PBF_category, ": ", PBF))) %>%
    select(`Physical and Biological Feature` = PBF_Display, 
           `Associated Species` = Species_List) %>%
    flextable() %>%
    theme_vanilla() %>%
    width(j = 1, width = 3.5) %>% 
    width(j = 2, width = 3.0) %>%
    valign(valign = "top", part = "all") %>%
    border_inner_h(border = fp_border(color="gray80", width = 1))
}
```

